dns_provider.desc: Automated DNS-01 supports Cloudflare and AliDNS. Configuration readiness does not prove provider permissions or certificate issuance.

dns_aliyun_access_key_id.name: AliDNS AccessKey ID
dns_aliyun_access_key_id.desc: Prefer private worker environment DNS_ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_ID. Nonempty DB values override it. Current platform config storage does not encrypt values at rest.

dns_aliyun_access_key_secret.name: AliDNS AccessKey Secret
dns_aliyun_access_key_secret.desc: Prefer private worker environment DNS_ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET. Nonempty DB values override it. Current platform config storage does not encrypt values at rest. Requires DNS record read/create/delete permissions.

dns_aliyun_zone.name: AliDNS DNS Zone
dns_aliyun_zone.desc: Registered DNS zone, e.g. example.com. Blank falls back to DNS_ALIYUN_ZONE_NAME. Challenge domains must belong to this exact zone or its children.

ssl_auto_renew_days.desc: Renewal lead time in whole days (1–60), default 30.

ssl_certificate.dns_provider_configured: {provider} configuration is present and syntactically valid; provider access has not been checked.
ssl_certificate.dns_provider_read_checked: {provider} zone read access was checked. DNS edit permission, delegation, CA issuance and deployed HTTPS remain unverified.
ssl_certificate.dns_provider_check_failed: DNS provider zone read check failed. Check credentials, permissions and zone configuration.
ssl_certificate.cloudflare_dns_not_configured: Cloudflare API token and zone ID are required for automated DNS-01.
ssl_certificate.aliyun_dns_not_configured: AliDNS AccessKey ID, secret and DNS zone are required; private worker environment values may supply them.
ssl_certificate.manual_dns_not_supported: Manual DNS does not support unattended certificate issuance.
ssl_certificate.dns_provider_legacy_unsupported: DNS provider {provider} has no supported automation adapter.
ssl_certificate.dns_provider_not_supported: Select a supported automated DNS provider. Manual mode is for development only.
ssl_certificate.dns_configuration_invalid: DNS provider credentials or zone configuration are invalid.
ssl_certificate.dns_zone_invalid: Enter a canonical DNS zone hostname without IP, URL, wildcard or port.
ssl_certificate.dns_record_invalid: Enter a valid DNS-01 challenge record and TXT value.
ssl_certificate.dns_zone_mismatch: The challenge hostname is outside the configured DNS zone.
ssl_certificate.dns_request_failed: DNS provider request failed. Check credentials and permissions.
ssl_certificate.dns_response_invalid: DNS provider returned an invalid response.
ssl_certificate.dns_pagination_limit: DNS provider result exceeds the pagination limit.
ssl_certificate.dns_record_already_owned: A challenge record is already pending for this operation. Clean it up before reusing the same token.
ssl_certificate.dns_record_changed: The owned challenge record was changed externally; cleanup stopped.
ssl_certificate.dns_provider_unsupported: DNS provider does not support an automated access check.
ssl_certificate.dns_acme_mode_invalid: Use the production Let's Encrypt directory for the production URL and the staging directory for the staging URL.
ssl_certificate.dns_renewal_days_invalid: SSL renewal lead time must be a whole number from 1 to 60 days.
